title: Grilling Destination Audit Ledger
purpose: The owned record of every unique question put to the owner in grilling sessions while designing the Workbench: the question, the owner's answer, the reason, and the result the answer is meant to produce. The v4 Workbench is audited against it. It is the record itself, not a projection of another file; readable views are rendered from it.
authority: Like every wiki record it routes and records; it authorizes no work by itself (AGENTS.md -> Authority Order).
provenance: Compiled 2026-09-24 by Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) from the local grilling notes, the 2026-09-19 grilling progress board, the 2026-09-23 destination audit (254 verdict rows), its completeness addendum, and the owner answers recovered from transcripts (triage v2). First published as Markdown in PR #149; replaced by this JSON at the owner's direction on 2026-09-24.

counting.aliases_note: The twelve original Task/Ticket/Chat questions (Q1-Q12 of the 2026-09-10 clarification note) are the same questions as TT-Q1..TT-Q12 and are recorded as aliases.

field_guide.question: The latest faithful wording. Reconstructed questions are flagged in notes.

status.answered-in-chat: The owner answered in a session but the note was never updated; recovered from his own messages.
status.partially-answered: The owner answered part of the question; notes say which part is open.
status.withdrawn: Not an owner question, or withdrawn in session.
status.superseded: Replaced by a later answer, named in the row.
status.not-a-question: Recorded as not a real question.

field_guide.answer: The owner's settled answer, in his words where they carry the meaning.
field_guide.reason: Why he answered that way. "Inference:" marks a reason derived from context; "Not recorded." means no reason survives in any source.
field_guide.result: The durable effect the answer should have: {artifact, action: create|update|retire|none, effect}. This is what the audit checks. Paths are as of 2026-09-24; an ADR or Spec that moves between lifecycle folders keeps its ID.
field_guide.source_refs: The local, untracked working records (notepads, transcripts, recovery files) the row came from, named so the source can be traced on the owner's machine. They are not durable evidence; this ledger is their durable copy.
field_guide.counted: false only for REC rows, which were recovered from transcripts and stay outside the 240 count.

maintenance: Add a question only when the owner actually answered it in a grilling session, with its source record. When a later answer replaces an earlier one, mark the earlier question superseded and name the replacement; never delete a question. Keep the file valid for tools/test-grilling-ledger.mjs.

progress_assessment.method: Each question's Result items were checked against the tree at this integration commit: the named artifact and section must exist and say what the Answer says (with any named templates/ mirror matching), and owning Spec and Task state was read from the Spec records and Task files, not the Taskboard projection. The 2026-09-23 destination-audit verdicts were used only as pointers, never copied. Superseded questions carry no obligation of their own and name their successor, so no question is counted twice. Evidence citations read at this commit; 'unverified:' marks a reading the assessor could not settle.

statuses.implemented-and-completed: Every Result artifact exists at the pinned commit and says what the Answer says; any owning Spec or Task is complete.
statuses.specced: A Spec carries this answer, but no Task is cut for this part.
statuses.specced-and-tasked: The owning Spec has Tasks for it, and none has started.
statuses.in-progress: A Task for it is claimed or in progress, or part of the Result is delivered and the rest is pending.
statuses.not-started: No Spec or Task carries it, and the Result is absent or contradicted.
statuses.no-build-obligation: Open, withdrawn, superseded, deferred past v4, not a question, or no artifact change.
